head: Every row.
Every scroll.
Every time.
body: Your LazyColumn redraws every visible row whenever anything changes.
There is usually one reason, and you handed it over yourself.

head: It redraws the room
*every time you blink
slides.caption: A gremlin that repaints the house when you were not looking, and does not mind an empty room. Feed it an unstable List and it repaints everything.

head: A List is not
a stable type
code: // before: List is unstable, rows cannot skip
// after: an immutable list is stable, skipping works

items.title: Or mark the holder @Immutable
items.sub: when you can promise it never mutates

items.title: Measure, do not guess
items.sub: turn on recomposition counts and scroll

head: Compose is fast.
You handed it a
*puzzle
body: It can skip anything it can prove did not change. Stability is that proof.
Most "Compose is janky" is really "I gave it something it could not reason about".
